links.outcome: Comprehension and subjective understanding of original vs GPT-4 plain-language translated medical notes
links.effect: Translated notes yielded higher objective comprehension scores, greater subjective understanding, higher perceived empathy, and reduced mental effort and negative emotions; reading times did not differ.
links.quote: LLM translation of medical notes significantly improved both objective and subjective patient understanding.
